findings.title: Payment Terms
findings.deviation: Lakeshore may not pay undisputed amounts within 30 days of receipt of invoice; payment is only for accepted deliverables on convenience termination.
findings.impact: This is less favorable for AtliQ as it may delay cash flow.
findings.clauseRef:
4.3 Lakeshore shall pay the Fees set out in each SOW. The Fees for SOW-1 total USD 64,000, payable by milestone as set out in Exhibit B.
4.4 Pre-approved travel expenses shall be reimbursed at cost in accordance with Lakeshore's travel policy.
4.5 Fees are exclusive of applicable sales and use taxes, which Lakeshore shall pay except for taxes based on Vendor's net income.
findings.quote: Lakeshore shall pay the Fees set out in each SOW. The Fees for SOW-1 total USD 64,000, payable by milestone as set out in Exhibit B. Pre-approved travel expenses shall be reimbursed at cost in accordance with Lakeshore's travel policy. Fees are exclusive of applicable sales and use taxes, which Lakeshore shall pay except for taxes based on Vendor's net income.
findings.counterPosition: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid; set-off limited to undisputed amounts under this agreement.

findings.title: Indemnity
findings.deviation: Vendor indemnifies Lakeshore for third-party claims, but not for Lakeshore's own negligence; no carve-out for data incidents.
findings.impact: This is less favorable for AtliQ as it does not provide full protection.
findings.clauseRef:
10.1 Vendor shall defend and indemnify Lakeshore against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe a U.S. patent, copyright or trademark or misappropriate a trade secret.
10.2 Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims for bodily injury or property damage to the extent caused by its negligence or willful misconduct.
findings.quote: Vendor shall defend and indemnify Lakeshore against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe a U.S. patent, copyright or trademark or misappropriate a trade secret. Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims for bodily injury or property damage to the extent caused by its negligence or willful misconduct.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).
findings.linkedQuote: Vendor shall defend and indemnify Lakeshore against third-party claims alleging that the Deliverables infringe a U.S. patent, copyright or trademark or misappropriate a trade secret. Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims for bodily injury or property damage to the extent caused by its negligence or willful misconduct.

findings.title: Termination
findings.deviation: Lakeshore may terminate any SOW for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, and shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination.
findings.impact: This is less favorable for AtliQ as it may result in reduced revenue on termination.
findings.clauseRef: 5.3 Lakeshore may terminate any SOW for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, and shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination.
findings.quote: Lakeshore may terminate any SOW for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, and shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.
findings.linkedQuote: Lakeshore may terminate any SOW for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, and shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination.

findings.title: Data Protection
findings.deviation: No specific data protection agreement or sub-agreements are mentioned, and no offshore access route is defined.
findings.impact: This is less favorable for AtliQ as it may expose data to risks without proper protections.
findings.clauseRef:
12.1 Vendor shall comply with Lakeshore's Information Security Requirements (Exhibit C) and applicable privacy laws, including the Illinois Personal Information Protection Act.
12.2 Vendor shall notify Lakeshore within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering any unauthorized access to Lakeshore Data.
12.3 Upon completion of the Services, Vendor shall return or securely delete Lakeshore Data.
findings.quote: Vendor shall comply with Lakeshore's Information Security Requirements (Exhibit C) and applicable privacy laws, including the Illinois Personal Information Protection Act. Vendor shall notify Lakeshore within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering any unauthorized access to Lakeshore Data. Upon completion of the Services, Vendor shall return or securely delete Lakeshore Data.
findings.counterPosition: Execute the DPA/BAA and the sub-agreements first; agree a de-identified offshore route in writing; cap data-incident liability at a super-cap.
findings.linkedQuote: Vendor shall comply with Lakeshore's Information Security Requirements (Exhibit C) and applicable privacy laws, including the Illinois Personal Information Protection Act. Vendor shall notify Lakeshore within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering any unauthorized access to Lakeshore Data. Upon completion of the Services, Vendor shall return or securely delete Lakeshore Data.
